<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Get all green block centers
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
greens = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(greens)}")

# Get centers
actions = []
for g in greens:
    boundary = g['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    center_row = sum(rows) // len(rows)
    center_col = sum(cols) // len(cols)
    actions.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_row, 'col': center_col})

print(f"Removing {len(actions)} green blocks...")
action(actions)

# Check result

greens2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Remaining green: {len(greens2)}")
print(f"Step: {current_frame.step}")
print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
print(f"Done: {last_action_result.get('done')}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"Executed: {last_action_result.get('executed_count', 'N/A')}")
</parameter>
</function>
